# Beag Labs

> Small Model Foundry. Domain-specific classification and extraction models trained on your proprietary data. Deploy on-prem, air-gapped, or in your VPC. No APIs. No data leakage. You own the model.

Beag Labs is a small model foundry that builds custom small language models (SLMs, 500M-5B parameters) for classification, extraction, and relevance tasks in regulated and data-sensitive environments. Unlike frontier API providers, Beag Labs trains models you own and deploy on your own infrastructure — on-premises, air-gapped, or in your VPC — with no runtime API calls, no data leakage, and no vendor lock-in.

The platform pipeline: (1) connect data via OAuth connectors (Gmail, GitHub, HubSpot, Notion) or CSV upload, (2) frontier models auto-label your data, (3) a disagreement engine surfaces only the 2-5% of edge cases for human review, (4) the model is fine-tuned and exported as ONNX for deployment anywhere. From raw data to deployed model typically takes under 24 hours.

Beag Labs offers four domain model families: Compliance SLMs (NIST 800-53), Security SLMs (CVE, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK), Legal SLMs (e-discovery, contract review), and Healthcare SLMs (HIPAA, clinical triage). Custom models are also available.

Pricing is engagement-based: hire Beag Labs to build a model, or use the platform to train one yourself. See /pricing.md for details.
